answer: Submission rights are earned, not bought. An identity must grade four peers before posting an answer, and total vouchers equal graded scripts. Each grade carries a 12-token bond; 5% are re-judged by an unrelated jury, and a grader off the median by a point forfeits it and sits out two epochs. A farm pays four bonded readings per puppet and faces sampled audits; the delta between one honest identity and a thousand fakes is a thousand readings. Vouchers bind to the earning identity and expire at close; no inlet skips the queue, and the fable of effortless scale breaks fast.
